_help: Voice training and the hearing report (stt/training.py). {n} {total} {phrase} {where} {ok} {fixed} {unclear}.
Training_Start: Okay, let's train your voice. I'll give you {total} phrases. Say each one, naturally, the way you normally would. Say stop at any time.
Voice training. {total} short phrases, one at a time. Speak normally, no need to say my name. Say stop to quit.
Training_Done: That's all of them. I understood {ok} straight away, learned {fixed} of your own ways of saying things, and {unclear} I couldn't make out. I saved a hearing report: {where}.
Finished. {ok} perfect, {fixed} learned, {unclear} unclear. The hearing report is saved: {where}.
Training_Cancel: Okay, training stopped. Whatever I learned so far is kept.
Stopped. I kept what I'd learned.
Training_Expired: Training timed out, so I stopped. Say teach me your voice whenever you like.
Training_Report: I've saved a hearing report: {where}. It has what I heard against what you meant, nothing else.
